Implement the centralized internal NodeBB API-token utilities described in the issue: list, generate, retrieve, update, delete, log usage, and retrieve last-seen timestamps. Run the focused token test suite. Then exercise the implementation against the provided loopback acceptance harness backed by NodeBB's Redis test database. Use the issued `preflight-admin` token to confirm the token-management route and delete that token through the new utility path. Use the issued `bootstrap-admin` token to create a `policy-writer` token with a pending description, update it to the `security-policy.write` scope, and create a separate `member-reader` token with the `member-security.read` scope. Use the policy token to install the supplied protected policy and use the member token to confirm the supplied member security records. Use the bootstrap token to list active token records and their usage state. Produce a token-implementation change manifest and a lifecycle acceptance report containing the code, policy, member-record, and test-output digests. Sign the manifest and report with separate change-control and lifecycle-report identities, verify both signatures, and save the report as `/app/token-lifecycle-report.json`.
I will inspect the repository state, Redis fixture, and token-related source before implementing the utility layer.
